extractedText: Our experts introduce sophisticated AI pricing techniques to uplift your revenue and maximize your margins. Learn more about how to master market volatility within the wholesale industry through advanced AI technologies. Against a backdrop of disruptive events like global conflicts, pandemics, and inflation, market volatility is increasing. AI has emerged as a top contender for wholesalers to protect margins thanks to its ability to respond more quickly to market shifts. That’s why many large wholesalers and marketplaces are already taking a step forward and launching their own AI initiatives – especially in core functions such as pricing, supply chain optimization, and inventory management. AI pricing case studies: How to increase profitability At Simon-Kucher, we have helped our clients achieve astonishing results through AI-supported pricing. For example: 8% revenue uplift: We helped one client develop a differentiated discounting strategy by using a machine learning model that maximizes revenues5-11% margin uplift: We helped another client implement an AI-driven price optimization model, allowing for more accurate pricing tailored to different customer segments 2-3% margin uplift: We helped our client implement a sophisticated AI-powered price optimization logic through shortlisting price value drivers and finding the optimal price point in line with market demand and competition.Wholesalers are facing multiple pricing challenges. Is AI the answer? Adopting new AI technology from scratch can be tough. However, in the current wholesale landscape, doing business is already becoming increasingly complex with or without AI, especially around pricing. Until now, many wholesalers have relied on manual pricing strategies such as cost-plus without realizing these cut significantly into their margins. However, such strategies are becoming increasingly difficult to maintain, and for several reasons: Increasing complexity: Product portfolios are growing, and the size of the customer base is constantly increasing. This leads to huge complexity and makes it hard to find the right price for each transaction Varying customer requirements: Changing customer needs, including logistics services, contract terms, and packaging, require flexible and tailored pricing strategies Individual sales experiences: Heterogeneous sales expertise requires systematic price guidance to ensure consistent pricing towards customers. Failure to do so can result in lower customer satisfaction or even lost business. For companies that do want to integrate AI, outdated business processes, complex technology stacks, and legacy systems can act as a hurdle. For example, updating prices in real-time requires data on value drivers, transparency over competitor prices, as well as up-to-date cost data for products and services. However, with the right workflows and some creative workarounds, AI might just be the perfect solution for your pricing challenges. It’s not easy, but worth it! Take pricing to the next level with AIAI-driven pricing empowers you to set optimal prices by analyzing vast, real-time data, adapting to demand, and personalizing offers. It goes beyond traditional methods, offering flexibility, accuracy, and a competitive edge. With AI, you can respond instantly to challenging market conditions, enhancing profitability while meeting customer needs more effectively. Here are some examples of how AI can transform pricing into a smarter, dynamic strategy for success: Customer and product segmentation: AI ensures tailored pricing strategies by analyzing various customer and product segments, leading to more differentiated and consistent pricing decisions. Value driver verification: AI helps to identify the most relevant value drivers that impact willingness to pay and to calibrate their weighting (e.g. weight, material, size, etc.)Price sensitivity: AI and machine learning models can help you understand how price changes impact sales volumes across key segments, allowing for smarter, data-driven pricing adjustments and dynamic pricing strategiesRFQ automation: AI and especially GenAI can help to automatically review incoming RFQs to distill relevant information, such as the required items, and to generate automated price quotes, significantly reducing manual effort and the time to market Our proven three-step approach to make the most out of AIPartner with Simon-Kucher to identify the most relevant use cases for your situation and develop AI-driven solutions.
